changelog: FIX: Resolved a visual glitch where the application window would briefly flash white for a split second during startup.
FIX: Fixed an issue in the Audio Monitor where text labels failed to update immediately after a language change, requiring an application restart.
CHANGED: Implemented various UI/UX refinements and enhancements to improve the look and feel of the interface.
CHANGED: Conducted major code refactoring and under-the-hood optimization for a cleaner, more efficient codebase.
CHANGED: Improved overall application stability, reducing potential crashes during long-haul flights.
NEW: Integrated the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy agreement window that appears upon first launch before using the software.
NEW: Introduced foundational code changes and preparations in anticipation of the upcoming 1.0 full release.
